title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR PROPERTY RIGHTS TO SLUM DWELLERS ACT, 2012
full_text: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR PROPERTY RIGHTS TO SLUM DWELLERS ACT, 2012 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201211 Act Number: 11 Enactment Date: 2012-04-25 Act Year: 2012 Short Title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR PROPERTY RIGHTS TO SLUM DWELLERS ACT, 2012 Long Title: An Act to provide for facilitation of inclusive growth and slum-free cities, lay down general principles applicable to slum-free cities in all spheres of Government and according property rights to slum dwellers and to provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of Revenue Enforcement Date: 2012-04-26 Type: STATE Location: Jammu and Kashmir TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Property Rights in the form of dwelling space. Section 4. Ins-itu redevelopment and up-gradation of all tenable slums. Section 5. Conditions for allotment of a dwelling space. Section 6. Process of identification of eligible slum dwellers, grant of legal entitlement and dispute resolution. Section 7. Establishment of District Slum Area Redevelopment Committee. Section 8. Establishment of City Slum Redevelopment Committee. Section 9. Conduct of business and appointment of Staff Section 10. Powers and Duties of the City Slum Redevelopment Committee and District Slum Redevelopment Committee. Section 11. Scheme for redevelopment, up-gradation in and Resettlement of Slum. Section 12. State Slum Redevelopment Authority. Section 13. Powers and Functions of the State Authority. Section 14. Power of Government to acquire land. Section 15. Land acquired by Government to be made available to the City/District Slum Redevelopment Committee. Section 16. Compensation for acquisition of land. Section 17. Responsibility to prevent encroachments. Section 18. Penalty for contravention of the Act and rules. Section 19. Offences to be cognizable. Section 20. Information, reports or returns. Section 21.
